fields.stage: Active, not recruiting Phase 2 combination study; separate Phase 1 study not yet recruiting
fields.summary: The sponsor-submitted registry records an active, not recruiting Phase 2 study (record updated 9 October 2026) of macupatide and eloralintide, alone or in combination, in an estimated 200 adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes. It records an actual 16 October 2025 start and estimated March 2027 primary completion. A separate Japanese Phase 1 study remains not yet recruiting and has only an estimated October 2026 start.
fields.limitations: Active, not recruiting status is not a result. Neither study has posted results, estimated enrolment and completion dates may change, and the Phase 1 study must not be described as started while its registry status remains not yet recruiting.

fields.stage: Phase 1b completed without posted registry results; Phase 2 planned
fields.summary: A once-daily oral, peripherally restricted CB1 inverse agonist. Corbus reported CANYON-1 topline Phase 1b results on 14 September 2026 after 12 weeks of treatment. A Phase 2 monotherapy study was planned for the first half of 2027, not yet treated as started. The registry update posted on 9 October 2026 records CANYON-1 as completed with 254 actual participants and actual primary and study completion on 3 August 2026.
fields.limitations: The 9 October registry update confirms completed status but has no posted results. The September sponsor topline announcement remains separate evidence for findings, not registry results or a head-to-head comparison. Planned Phase 2 remains unconfirmed as started.

fields.summary: NIDDK's NCT05713799 record describes an oral mirabegron and alpha-lipoic acid crossover pilot in adults with obesity. The 9 October 2026 update remains not yet recruiting, with its estimated start moved again to 14 October 2026, 60 estimated participants and estimated March 2030 completion. Its primary endpoint is insulin sensitivity, with metabolic and exploratory body-composition outcomes.
fields.limitations: First posted in February 2023: an older study, not an October medicine launch. The 14 October start remains estimated, not actual dosing, and no results are posted. The detailed protocol retains a 48-person target while the enrolment field estimates 60; this discrepancy is preserved. Metabolic study aims are not demonstrated weight-loss benefit, a prescribing recommendation or approval of this combination.
